headline: Xbox picks up Kojima's Physint after PlayStation dropped it
summary: Hideo Kojima's new game, Physint, will now be published by Xbox. PlayStation previously cancelled its plans to publish the title. This marks an unexpected platform swap for the Metal Gear creator's project.

headline: Volvo XC40 PHEV is back with a new look, better sensors, and Gemini AI
summary: Volvo is reintroducing its XC40 Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV) model. The updated version features a major facelift, enhanced sensors, and Gemini AI integration. It will arrive at dealerships early next year after a three-year hiatus.

headline: There aren't AirPods with cameras yet and I hope it stays that way
summary: Apple unveiled its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, and the iPhone 18 Pro. Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) is now available on the entry-level AirPods 5. A new Siri Recap feature will also be integrated into AirPods.

headline: The black iPhone Pro returns
summary: Apple has reintroduced a black color option for the iPhone Pro lineup. The previous iPhone 17 Pro models lacked a black or dark gray option. Fans can once again choose a classic black finish for the high-end iPhone.

headline: In The Wandering Earth: The Last Full Moon, You Must Get Rid of The Moon
summary: A new game titled 'The Wandering Earth: The Last Full Moon' has been revealed. The central premise involves players needing to eliminate the moon. It's a sci-fi themed game with a unique and intriguing objective.

headline: Proof-of-Age Verification for Steam in Australia Now Only Possible Using a Credit Card
summary: Steam now requires a credit card for age verification in Australia. This policy differs from PlayStation and Xbox, which offer multiple verification methods. The new requirement is controversial as only about half of Australians own credit cards.

headline: Hideo Kojima's Metal Gear Solid Spiritual Successor Physint Will Now Be Published by Xbox Instead of Sony
summary: Hideo Kojima's upcoming project Physint will now be published by Xbox instead of Sony. Microsoft announced an expanded partnership with Kojima Productions. This collaboration extends beyond games to include film and television projects.

headline: The People v. Gorilla Grodd Set Video Shows DC Villain Singing Backstreet Boys
summary: New behind-the-scenes footage from 'The People v. Gorilla Grodd' has surfaced. The video shows the DC supervillain Gorilla Grodd singing. He performs Backstreet Boys' 'As Long as You Love Me' in an a cappella group.

headline: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterm elections
summary: Former President Trump pledged $5,000 for every adult American if Republicans win midterm elections. He offered no details on the plan's funding or implementation. The promise was made during a party convention speech.

headline: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
summary: President Trump promised $5,000 to every American if the Republican Party wins November's midterms. Questions are being raised about the legality of this election pledge. The proposal has sparked debate and scrutiny.

headline: England's mayors to be given power to introduce tourist tax
summary: English mayors are set to gain powers to implement a tourist tax. The government will detail how local leaders can impose levies on overnight stays. This new power aims to generate revenue for local areas.

headline: RNLI reviews security after volunteers targeted online
summary: The RNLI is reviewing security measures after its volunteers faced online targeting. Volunteers were harassed following their assistance in Channel migrant rescues on Sunday. The organization is taking steps to protect its personnel from online abuse.
